c74object.name: gst.riot
c74object.digest: Input data interface for Ircam IMU receiver modules
c74object.description: gst.riot is an input data interface for Ircam IMU receiver modules. It is compatible with RIoT IMU modules (RIoT2 and v3). It relies on sending Open Sound Control ( OSC ) messages via UDP over Ethernet. Check available port with you Operating System (Mac OS ). gst.riot uses internal send/receive to spread resampling clock informations : frameperiod, framerate and sync messages.

inlet.description: OSC id number is specified in your IMU device (RIoT) or CoMo.te application.
Port number is specified in your IMU device (RIoT) or CoMo.te application. It must be an available port of your OS in order to assigned to Max application.
